suppress.notes:
Added 2026-10-09. CVE-2022-31691 concerns YAML editors in Spring Tools for Eclipse and VSCode extensions. spring-boot-loader-tools is the executable-archive packaging library, not an IDE extension, and contains none of those YAML editors. The scanner confuses the independent Spring Boot version with the Spring Tools product version. No upgrade of the packaging library fixes this product mismatch; SnakeYAML dependencies remain scanned. https://spring.io/security/cve-2022-31691/
Mitigation: The packaging library runs only during the build that repackages an executable archive, and its SnakeYAML dependencies stay scanned. The entry is removed once Dependency-Check stops matching the library to Spring Tools, or with the Spring Boot upgrade after which it no longer does.
